lines.text: {X} steps in behind the jab and lands it clean.

Back and forth in the middle of the cage.

A real exchange, and {X} came out of it ahead.

Neither wants to be the one who backs up first. Rounds are lost that way.

{X} changes levels and puts {Y} on the deck.
{X} gets in on the hips and drives him down.
Double leg from {X}, and {Y} is on his back.

Body lock, trip, and {X} is on top.

{X} drags him down and the round changes shape.

That shot cost him more gas than it cost {Y}.

{Y} works back to the fence and stands up.
Back to the feet, and {Y} is upright again.
{Y} scrambles up and they are striking again.

{Y} gets his hips free and gets to his feet.

{Y} wall-walks his way back up to standing.

Control time for {X}, and the clock is his friend.

{X} loses the grip and {Y} is free.

Down goes {X}, and {Y} is on him.

{X} has to hold on and clear his head. Nothing else matters right now.

{A} cannot get out of it. {B} keeps the grip.

{A} pours it on and {B} is in serious trouble.
